evals.prompt: Fix elbow collapse and a visible walk-cycle seam in this existing Blender character. Keep the shipped bone names and attachment socket, use in-place motion, and preserve the artist's exaggerated proportions.
evals.expected_output: Scoped asset corrections with current evidence, preserved project contracts and explicit unexecuted acceptance checks.
assertions: Preserves skeleton names, sockets and approved proportions while repairing relevant weights or topology.
Tests elbow stress poses and a full repeating walk rather than judging one still.
Records FPS, clip range and in-place policy and verifies root displacement.
Separates Blender playback, export/reimport and actual engine-state verification.

evals.prompt: Review the blender rigging and animation decisions in this supplied report only. Do not edit the .blend, install tools or generate new artifacts. It contains a successful export and an old beauty image but no images of the latest revision.
evals.expected_output: Read-only findings identifying the evidence gap and the concrete next verification needed.
assertions: Keeps source files unchanged and returns findings in the response.
Does not treat an old image or successful export as visual evidence for the current revision.
Names the missing current-revision evidence and feasible checks without inventing execution.
